name: Pokedex Sprites (HGSS)
description: Replaces the Pokedex ENTRY PAGE art (highlight a caught Pokemon, choose DATA) with HeartGold/SoulSilver-style sprites for all 151 species, and repaints the caught-species marker on the dex list as a proper red-and-white Poke Ball instead of a flat black disc (CAUGHT BALL option: MODERN or VANILLA). The Gen 1 dex list draws no sprite of its own, so only the marker changes there. Battle, party summary, evolution, Hall of Fame and every other sprite site keep vanilla art. Fan-art sprite swap sourced from Bulbagarden Archives; personal use.
